Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 30, "var": "static_data", "code": "memcpy(static_data, data, size);", "note": "Attacker-controlled input is copied into the global static_data buffer"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 32, "var": "config", "code": "config = config_open_for_fuzzing(static_data, size);", "note": "The global buffer and its size are passed to the config parser; lexer->end = static_data + size"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_next", "line": 476, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "return lex_config(lexer);", "note": "lex_next dispatches to lex_config which begins tokenizing the input"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_config", "line": 434, "var": "chr", "code": "if (isstring(chr)) return lex_string;", "note": "lex_config reads the first byte 'a' via next(), determines it is a string character, and calls lex_string"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_string", "line": 292, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "chr = next(lexer);", "note": "lex_string repeatedly calls next() consuming all 32768 'a' bytes; after the last call, lexer->pos == lexer->end"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "next", "line": 237, "var": "lexer->pos", "code": "lexer->pos = lexer->end + 1;", "note": "When pos >= end, next() sets pos = end + 1 (one past the buffer) and returns '\\0'"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "lex_string", "line": 317, "var": "chr", "code": "backup(lexer);", "note": "isstring('\\0') is false, so lex_string calls backup() to un-consume the terminator"},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/lib/lwan-config.c", "function": "backup", "line": 279, "var": "*lexer->pos", "code": "lexer->pos--; if (*lexer->pos == '\\n') lexer->cur_line--;", "note": "backup decrements pos from end+1 to end (= static_data + 32768), then reads *pos which is 1 byte past the global array: GLOBAL-BUFFER-OVERFLOW READ 1"}
]
EOF
echo "Trace created"
